description: Rewrite articles with a built-in synonym engine covering 130+ common English words. Whole-word replacement with capitalization preserved and a change report.

faqs.a: It swaps common words with synonyms from a built-in dictionary, preserving capitalization and punctuation. It is a starting point, not a human rewrite.
No. Everything runs locally in your browser and your text is never uploaded or stored.
Yes — it is a template-style tool. Always review and edit the output for accuracy and tone before publishing.
faqs.q: Should I publish the output as-is?

howto: Paste your article into the box.
Review the rewritten text and the change count.
Copy the result or download it as .txt.
title: Article Rewriter
